t: This is Phantom Peak, an adventure game in the United Kingdom. It's an interactive experience, so you take part rather than watch. It was founded by Nick Moran, who designs escape rooms and interactive entertainment, and you can see that in the format: puzzles, characters and a story you move through yourself. I don't have more detail about the setting or how it runs, so I'll say no more. If you're planning a visit, check what's currently on offer.
